name: David Trias
summary: In Deathknell, David Trias trains the newly awakened Forsaken. He teaches stealth and bladecraft so they can serve Queen Sylvanas and the Forsaken.

sections.title: A Guide from the Shadows
sections.body: David Trias trains newly risen undead among Deathknell’s tombstones and ruins. He seeks those with a talent for killing unseen. For the fledgling Forsaken, survival calls for more than strength at arms; it calls for precise strikes from the dark. Trias deciphers orders and teaches initiates to wield daggers, hide their movements, and use their reanimated reflexes with lethal precision against the living and the Scourge.

sections.title: A Familiar Name
sections.body: David Trias shares a surname with Elling Trias, a well-known cheese merchant in Stormwind. Elling secretly maintains close ties to master rogues and spymasters. No family connection between David and Elling is confirmed.

faq.answer: David Trias trains newly awakened Forsaken rogues in Deathknell, in Tirisfal Glades. He teaches their first combat techniques and gives them their first covert assignments.

faq.q: Where can I find David Trias?
faq.answer: Find David Trias in Deathknell, the Forsaken starting village in Tirisfal Glades. He stands near the settlement’s structures, helping newly risen undead.

faq.q: Is David Trias related to Elling Trias in Stormwind?
aliases: is he related to elling trias
faq.answer: David Trias shares his surname with Elling Trias of Stormwind, but no family connection is confirmed.

faq.q: What role does he play in Forsaken training?
faq.answer: Newly risen rogues from Deathknell’s crypt bring David Trias an encrypted scroll. He deciphers their instructions, teaches their first skills, and guides them toward covert work for the Forsaken.

angles.text: As a Forsaken rogue, David Trias is your first mentor. He helps you decipher secret scrolls and teaches you to wield a blade with the cold precision of undeath.
As an undead, you know the Forsaken’s grim reality: you were once human in Lordaeron, but the plague severed you from your former life and lineage. Now you serve Queen Sylvanas.
